dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, visitors, property owners, and local stakeholders in Tulsa, Oklahoma, as well as appointed advisory commission members.
dimensions.evidence: there is established the Historic Greenwood District--Black Wall Street National Monument in the State of Oklahoma as a unit of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new national monument, authorizes land acquisition, and provides for a management plan and advisory commission.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may acquire any land or interest in land located within the boundary of the National Monument

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes land acquisition using donated or appropriated funds and provides travel expenses for commission members, but does not specify total cost.
dimensions.evidence: purchase from a willing seller with donated or appropriated funds

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new unit of the National Park System and establishes a temporary advisory commission.
dimensions.evidence: there is established the Historic Greenwood District--Black Wall Street National Monument in the State of Oklahoma as a unit of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent national monument, though the advisory commission terminates 10 years after establishment.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall terminate 10 years after the date on which the National Monument is established.

missing_information: Total expected cost of land acquisition and monument development.
importance_detail.rationale: S. 1051 establishes the Historic Greenwood District--Black Wall Street National Monument in Oklahoma as a unit of the National Park System and creates an advisory commission.
